prohibitions.statement: Accent ink relied on as the only readable signal where measured contrast < 3:1 — as a reusable-system guard. Measured in the deployment: pink/white 2.60, green/white 1.32, pink/code-blue 1.99, close-X/white 1.32. Pair the colour with another affordance (the dotted underline does this for links; nothing does it for body text) or use a sanctioned override.
Blurred/drop elevation shadows — depth is inset rings and rules only (P-R4).
